summary: A calmer workspace, continuous Notes, shared quick actions, and a permanent one-time workspace reset.

Added: Continuous rich-text Notes with nested folders, pins, tables, checklists, images, and durable file attachments
Default task layout and screen/project overrides in setup and Settings
Shared right-click, keyboard, and touch action menus across core items
Improved: Compact toolbars, task filtering, responsive Notes panes, and draft-safe autosave
Generation-gated sync and file transfers with resumable owner-scoped reset verification
Removed: Explore, Pages, user Databases, templates, saved filters, and Filters & labels
Pre-reset workspace data and incompatible backup readers; sign-in identity is retained
